name: ihav-web-imagen
description: Draw with the ChatGPT account you already have: one line, no API key, at most one request per run, original file saved.

interface.shortDescription: Draw with your own ChatGPT account, one request per run
interface.longDescription: Turns one line into one image through your signed-in ChatGPT account: a headless browser drives the normal ChatGPT Images page, sends at most one request, and saves the original file. Unofficial; no API key.
defaultPrompt: Draw a red fox in the snow with ihav-web-imagen.
Use ihav-web-imagen to edit this image: same pose, watercolor palette.
Set up ihav-web-imagen on this machine.
